name: The Forgotten Starlight Library
description: A hidden library tucked inside an ancient oak, its branches are made of silvered books, and shafts of starlight filter through, illuminating reading nooks.
prompt: A hidden Forgotten Starlight Library: ancient oak with branches forged from silvered books, interior filled with glowing reading alcoves, shafts of starlight piercing through leaves, dust motes sparkling, serene ambience, photorealistic, fantasy woodcraft.
caption: Discover the Forgotten Starlight Library—where the forest itself is a book of endless nights 🌟📖.
